name: Deflecting Scimitar
body:
Aura faint transmutation; Slot none; CL 9th; Weight 4 lbs.; Price 32,315 gp

DESCRIPTION

While wielding this +3 training scimitar you gain the benefit of the Deflect Arrows feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells magic weapon; Cost 16,315 gp
